# Gina's College of Advanced Aesthetics
> Ontario's only CIDESCO-accredited career college. Diploma and certificate programs in medical aesthetics, hairstyling, and aesthetics. OSAP-eligible. 3 campuses: Mississauga, Waterloo, and Ottawa. Founded 1979.

## About
Gina's College of Advanced Aesthetics Corporation is a registered private career college under the Ontario Career Colleges Act, 2005. The school has operated since 1979 and remains privately owned by the same family across three generations. It is the only career college in Ontario to hold CIDESCO international accreditation, which is recognized in over 40 countries. All four diploma programs qualify for OSAP (Ontario Student Assistance Program) funding. Approximately 70% of each diploma program is hands-on practical training in the student clinic, where students work on real paying clients under instructor supervision.

## Diploma Programs (OSAP-eligible)
- Medical Aesthetics Diploma — 12 months. Laser therapy, chemical peels, microneedling, advanced skin treatments. Average salary $55,000–$90,000+.
- Advanced Aesthetics Diploma — 10 months. Full aesthetician credential. Facials, waxing, body treatments, makeup, client management. CIDESCO pathway.
- Hairstyling Diploma — 12 months. Cutting, colouring, texture, styling. Professional salon environment with real clients.
- Electrolysis & Light Technology Diploma — 8 months. Permanent hair removal via electrolysis, laser, and IPL. Average salary $50,000–$80,000.

## Certificate Programs (short-duration specializations)
Microneedling, Chemical Peels, Nail Technology, Makeup Artistry, Lash Extensions, Eyebrow Design, Hot Stone Therapy, Reflexology, Hydrotherapy, Aromatherapy, Men's Grooming, Waxing Specialist, and more.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 1979
- Accreditation: CIDESCO International (only career college in Ontario)
- Registered: Ontario Career Colleges Act, 2005
- OSAP eligibility: Yes, all diploma programs
- Graduate employment rate: 95%+ within 90 days
- Average time to first job: 4 weeks after graduation
- Practical training: ~70% of diploma program time
- Campuses: 3 (Mississauga, Waterloo, Ottawa)

## Frequently Asked Questions
**Is Gina's College OSAP-eligible?** Yes. All four diploma programs qualify for OSAP. Gina's College is registered under the Ontario Career Colleges Act, 2005, which is required for OSAP eligibility.
**Is Gina's College CIDESCO-accredited?** Yes. It is the only career college in Ontario with CIDESCO accreditation. CIDESCO is the world's most recognized aesthetics credential, accepted in 40+ countries.
**How long are the programs?** Diploma programs run 8 to 12 months. Certificate programs run 3 weeks to 6 months depending on the course.
**Do students work on real clients?** Yes. The student clinic operates with real paying clients from the early weeks of each program.
**Where are the campuses?** Mississauga, Waterloo, and Ottawa, Ontario, Canada.
**How do I apply?** Apply at ginascollege.com/apply. No application fee. An admissions advisor responds within 24 hours.
**What salary can I expect after graduating?** Medical Aesthetics graduates average $55,000–$90,000+. Advanced Aesthetics graduates average $40,000–$65,000. Electrolysis & Light Technology graduates average $50,000–$80,000.
